candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care, Appendix A, printed p.22 / PDF p.26, 'Information Technology': receive, verify and implement health care provider orders; utilize resources to promote quality client care, including information technology
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — Information Technology / clinical decision support
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize electronic drug-interaction alerts delivered during order entry as clinical decision support that provides timely patient-specific information to support, not replace, clinical judgment.

options.C: A replacement for the nurse's clinical judgment
options.D: A patient-identification system unrelated to medication safety

candidate.rationale: Current HealthIT.gov/eCQI guidance identifies drug-drug interaction alerts delivered during workflows such as computerized order entry as clinical decision support (CDS). CDS provides timely, patient-specific information to support care decisions; it assists rather than replaces clinical judgment. Therefore A is correct. B and D describe unrelated functions, and C overstates the role of CDS.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Drug-drug interaction alerts delivered during order-entry workflows are a form of clinical decision support; CDS provides timely information that supports clinical decision-making rather than replacing clinician judgment.
candidate.source_document_title: Clinical decision support (CDS) alerts; Clinical Decision Support
candidate.source_locator: eCQI glossary, 'Clinical decision support (CDS) alerts': drug-drug, drug-allergy, and drug-disease interaction alerts and active CDS delivered during workflows such as order entry; HealthIT.gov 'How CDS Tools Support Care Decisions'
candidate.source_organization: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services — HealthIT.gov/eCQI Resource Center
candidate.source_version_date: CDS alerts last updated May 13, 2026; HealthIT.gov CDS page current in 2026; accessed 2026-08-17
candidate.stem: While entering a medication order in an electronic health record, the nurse receives an alert about a potential drug-drug interaction. What type of health-information technology is this alert?
